name: @fanchaozz/provider-manager
description: A pi extension that manages custom providers and models in ~/.pi/agent/models.json via a TUI dashboard, /providers slash command, and remote model sync.

scripts.test: for f in _test_*.mts; do node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings "$f" 2>&1 | tail -3; done
scripts.ci:test: npm install --no-save @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && for f in _test_*.mts; do node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings "$f" 2>&1 | tail -3; done
